name: kanban.cards
description: A skill-first Kanban board for projects, cards, comments, and visible execution.

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist public/app.js public/judgmentkit.css public/styles.css public/robots.txt .agents/skills/kanban-cards/scripts/kanban-cards-client.mjs
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:cli && npm run build:static
scripts.build:static: cp judgmentkit.css public/judgmentkit.css && cp styles.css public/styles.css && cp robots.txt public/robots.txt
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && tsx scripts/check-ui-contract.ts && npm run check:release-policy
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
